wholePhysicalScope: The mapped cathedral envelope fixes the plaza front, nave, and the footprint of the adjoining rear volume. The September 2022 public-domain plaza view controls the broad front gable, exterior timber stairs, decorated facade and belfry.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the broad tiled nave, plaza veranda, twin stairs and square belfry. Closer levels refine painted borders, roof and timber work, bell frame and galleries.
limitations: The model depicts the reconstructed cathedral in 2022 and the mapped attached rear range. Decorative painting and wood carving are simplified geometric interpretations.
The rear and side fenestration, bell tower dimensions and gallery framing are estimated from the map and plaza photograph.
The original terrain remains unchanged. The plaza floor and foundation contact down the side slope use approximate vertical registration.
